production.note: US model years 2010-2013. Start: GM's 2010 Grand Sport highlights: 'For 2010, it once again becomes part of the Corvette's lineup' and 'The Grand Sport replaces the Corvette's previous Z51 package'. End: GM's 2013 specifications cover the 'Corvette and Corvette Grand Sport' (gm-2013-corvette-specs); the C7 followed for 2014. No opened page says in so many words that 2013 was the last C6 Grand Sport.

displacementL.note: 6,162 cc. GM table: 'Displacement (cu in / cc): 376 / 6162' (2011; the 2013 table prints the same, gm-2013-corvette-specs).

aspiration.note: Inferred: no forced induction is listed for the LS3.

drivetrain.note: Front-engine, rear-wheel-drive Corvette; inferred, the table does not use the words 'rear-wheel drive'.

transmission.note: 'offered with either a six-speed manual or six-speed automatic transmission'; GM's 2011 table: 'six-speed manual' and 'six-speed paddle-shift automatic' (gm-2011-corvette-specs). Manual coupes add a dry-sump oiling system.

powerHp.note: Standard exhaust. Quote (GM 2011 table): "Horsepower (hp / kW @ rpm): 430 / 321 @ 5900* w/ std. exhaust 436 / 325 @ 5900* w/ opt. exhaust" (*SAE certified). GM's 2010 Grand Sport highlights: "The LS3 6.2L engine is rated at 430 horsepower (321 kW) and 424 lb.-ft. of torque"; the optional exhaust "elevates the power ratings to 436 horses (325 kW)" (gm-2010-grand-sport-highlights). The 2013 table prints the same ratings (gm-2013-corvette-specs). The rating did not change 2010-2013.

weightLb.note: Grand Sport coupe, 2011 model year. Quote (GM 2011 table, Grand Sport column): "Curb weight (lb / kg): ... 3311 / 1502 (coupe) 3289 / 1492 (convertible)". GM gives one figure per body, not per transmission. The 2013 table prints the same figures (gm-2013-corvette-specs). Reference year 2011 because no opened 2010 GM page gives a Grand Sport weight (the 2010 table lists only coupe, convertible and Z06; the 2010 highlights and brochure give none).
